name: GL_XFR_HISTORY
description: GL_XFR_HISTORY contains Oracle E-Business Suite to Oracle Fusion Cloud coexistence transfer run history.

columns.name: XFR_ID
columns.description: Unique number that indentifies the data transfer process.

columns.name: SYSTEM_ID
columns.description: Unique number that identifies the data transfer system.

columns.name: XFR_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Code that shows the type of the data transfer process.

columns.name: TOTAL_NUM_CHUNKS
columns.description: Total number of discrete chunk of data for the transfer run.

columns.name: CURRENT_CHUNK_NUM
columns.description: Number of current chunk of data being processed.

columns.name: XFR_STATUS_CODE
columns.description: Code that shows the state of the transfer process.

columns.name: XFR_REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Unique number that identifies the run of the transfer process.

columns.name: XFR_ERROR_MESSAGE
columns.description: Message that indicates the transfer process completed with an error.

columns.name: CONFIG_FILE_ID
columns.description: Unique number that indentifies the ledger configuration input file used in the transfer process.

columns.name: PERIOD_STATUS_DATA
columns.description: Period statuses input file used in the transfer process.

columns.name: BALANCES_DATA
columns.description: Balances input file used in the transfer process.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.
